instruments.notes: NYMEX contract period; open at 12/31/2001. Counterparties to open contracts are Bank One, NA and Bank of Montreal (not allocated by contract). Combined fair value of the Jan-Mar and Apr-Oct 2002 collars was approx $3.1 million; not designated as hedges, marked-to-market.
instruments.evidence_quote:
the Company has a collar on 40,000 Mmbtu of daily
natural gas production for the NYMEX contract period of January through March
of 2002, with a floor of $2.67/Mmbtu and a ceiling of $3.15/Mmbtu.

instruments.notes: Ceiling is an average ceiling. Open at 12/31/2001; unwound in February 2002 for net proceeds of approx $5.8 million ($.48 per Mmbtu). Combined fair value of both open collars approx $3.1 million. Counterparties Bank One, NA and Bank of Montreal (not allocated).
instruments.evidence_quote:
3TEC has placed 56,000 Mmbtu of daily natural gas production
from April through October of 2002 into a collar with a floor of $2.90/Mmbtu
and an average ceiling of $3.38/Mmbtu.

instruments.notes: Entered February 2002 after unwinding the April-October 2002 collar; swap period not explicitly stated in text. Subsequent event, not open at 12/31/2001.
instruments.evidence_quote:
During February 2002, the Company unwound the April through October 2002
collar for net proceeds of approximately $5.8 million ($.48 per Mmbtu), and
then swapped 56,000 Mmbtu of daily natural gas production at $2.56/Mmbtu.

instruments.notes: Put in place February 2002 (subsequent event); ceiling is a weighted average ceiling.
instruments.evidence_quote:
Also
during February 2002, the Company put in place a collar on 20,000 Mmbtu of
daily gas production from November 2002 to March 2003 with a floor of
$3.20/Mmbtu and a weighted average ceiling of $3.53/Mmbtu.

instruments.notes: Historical 2000 fixed swap at weighted average NYMEX WTI price; settled by end of 2000 (no open derivatives at 12/31/2000); reduced 2000 oil revenues by $2.1 million.
instruments.evidence_quote:
In February 2000, the Company entered into fixed swap agreements covering
2,000 barrels of oil per day for the period March through October 2000 at a
weighted average NYMEX West Texas Intermediate price of $25.96 per barrel.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Natural gas collars/swap entered in Q4 2001 and Feb 2002 were not designated as hedges; marked-to-market through earnings. Counterparties Bank One and Bank of Montreal (credit facility lenders).
